paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.85% on average, with DAX strongest (+1.13%) and Nikkei 225 weakest (-4.20%). Brent crude changed +0.78% to 109.64. Gold changed -1.67% to 4,073.6001. Bitcoin changed -0.93% to 80,558.7188. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.997%, a relative move of -2.35%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (-9.64%) and HSBC (-6.99%) moved the most.
